limitationTriage.limitation: The four-state step rests on a computer certificate
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a structural proof that four points are safe?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: cut-decomposition proof of positive definiteness (Lemma 5) obtained; a structural proof of the vertex tests was attempted in revision and did not land
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: two independent exact certificates are given instead

limitationTriage.limitation: No characterisation of failing five-state matrices
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does failure at five points require a pentagonal-inequality violation?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: reviewer numerical search over random l1 metrics on five and six points found no failure (not a certificate)

limitationTriage.limitation: Constant term of the worst case for PD MTI similarities with fair observations
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What is the constant in sup G for PD MTI or tree similarities?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: bracket between -(5/2) log 2 - 1/2 and log 2 - 1 proved (Theorem 10(b)); effective ranges computed (Remark 11)

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What is the smallest weighted tree with nonconcave entropy?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: equal-edge stars settled exactly (13 states); general trees open

limitationTriage.limitation: Rarity of failures quantified only numerically
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: How often do five-state PD MTI similarities fail?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: seeded experiment: 0 of 2000 random five-state PD MTI similarities fail the exact test; failure interval of width about 0.033 for K_{2,3}(a)
